amendments.reason: SSTIK5 is the procedure the SOP assigns an RNAV jet from 01L in 28/01, and EBAYE is not one of its transitions, but SUSEY is and SUSEY always connects to EBAYE (route building), so the SID is kept; SADDE8 is a conventional arrival and the flight is RNAV-capable; EBAYE usually connects to BURGL (route building), and BURGL is an entry fix of IRNMN2 (CA-LAX-IRNMN), so the route is built onto IRNMN2 via BURGL
